delivery_quality_gap: The retired Average Delivery Time aggregate analytics has no confirmed one-to-one replacement. Current restriction/error-index/posting-promise families reduce the diagnostic blind spot. Optional check/checkout can provide prospective scenario-specific delivery evidence only after full contract, PII and side-effect review.
bridge_rule: No graph authorizes automatic fan-out. Each read/calculation request and each pagination step must be an explicit controlled provider operation. Delivery check/checkout must not run automatically across seller catalog or customers.
completion_rule: Logistics diagnostics surface is not implementation-ready until every selected current target has an Ozon-owned full contract, identifier joins, history/pagination and operational limits. Conditional delivery quote operations additionally require PII and side-effect classification.
